darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
Usage: context-awesome [options] [command]

CLI for querying curated awesome-list context

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  sections [options] <query...>  Find awesome-list sections matching the query
  search [options] <query...>    Search awesome-list items
  items [options] <target>       Fetch items from a list by githubRepo
                                 (owner/repo) or UUID listId
  help [command]                 display help for command

Examples:
  # Find sections in awesome lists by topic
  context-awesome sections "graph databases"
  context-awesome sections "machine learning" --limit 5

  # Search items across all lists
  context-awesome search "postgres ORM"
  context-awesome search "redis" --sort stars

  # Fetch items from a specific list (owner/repo or UUID listId)
  context-awesome items sindresorhus/awesome
  context-awesome items sindresorhus/awesome --section Testing

  # Output JSON for scripting
  context-awesome search "redis" --json
